problem_text:
A logistics company needs to select packages for a shipment. Available packages are:
* Package 1: volume 49 cubic feet, revenue $211
* Package 2: volume 3 cubic feet, revenue $102
* Package 3: volume 16 cubic feet, revenue $260
* Package 4: volume 15 cubic feet, revenue $75
* Package 5: volume 18 cubic feet, revenue $190
* Package 6: volume 21 cubic feet, revenue $232
* Package 7: volume 7 cubic feet, revenue $295
* Package 8: volume 19 cubic feet, revenue $287
* Package 9: volume 13 cubic feet, revenue $161
* Package 10: volume 50 cubic feet, revenue $236
* Package 11: volume 33 cubic feet, revenue $246
The cargo container has a maximum capacity of 170 cubic feet. Choose the package combination that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this volume limit. Each package must be either fully accepted or rejected.
